notes: 5.190.1 FIXED THE ROUTE AND THE PANE STILL SAID "0 of 0 quarters". Driving the route directly answered 200 with 8 quarters, 7 plotted, 104 holders — so the server was right and the client was not reaching it. otsFetch IS THE BOUND AND NOTHING ELSE: it returns the RAW Response and adds NO auth token. cmFetch is the door — it carries the token, parses the body, and turns a refusal into an Error whose PAYLOAD travels with it. The 5.189.0 loader called the bound directly, so the request went out unauthenticated AND the handler received a Response where it expected a payload. r.series was undefined
